_about: The duas the Doa page lists. A dalil entry in the notes joins one with "dua": "<key>". Topics are listed in page order, and so are the duas within a topic.

hint.ms: Doa yang dipanjatkan Nabi SAW dan para nabi dalam peristiwa sirah.
hint.en: Duas the Prophet SAW and the prophets made during the events of the Sirah.

hint.ms: Ayat dan hadis tentang cara dan waktu berdoa.
hint.en: Verses and hadith on how and when to make dua.
